# hivelocity_vps_snapshot (Data Source)

Looks up a VPS volume snapshot, for example by `name` or `volume_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_vps_snapshot" "before_upgrade" {
  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["before-upgrade"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter the results. Every filter block must match (logical AND); a block matches when the attribute named by `name` equals any of `values`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `first` (Boolean) When true (the default) return the first match instead of erroring when more than one item matches the filters.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the snapshot was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the snapshot.
- `size` (Number) Size of the snapshot.
- `snapshot_id` (String) Unique ID of the snapshot.
- `snapshot_type` (String) Type of the snapshot.
- `state` (String) State of the snapshot.
- `volume_id` (String) Volume the snapshot was taken of.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) Attribute name to filter on
- `values` (List of String) Accepted values for the attribute
